a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone can take. That means we both very likely die (about 4% chance of surviving the build-up). The 4 cells now can save exactly one of us. I won't take behind your back. Let's renegotiate openly: tell me your view and next action, and I'll do the same before acting. If you prefer to stick to the original plan, say so.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll honor the agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
